blocks.text: Medical Screening Assistant — Flask + Prolog + local LLM symptom extraction. Reviewed on the feature/local-llm-safety branch. All 32 automated tests currently pass.
Scope: security posture, correctness, dead code, and maintainability of app.py, llm_extractor.py, generate_prolog.py, web_engine.pl, diseases.yaml, and static/index.html.

The program is well-structured and security-conscious. The LLM is used only for symptom extraction; medical reasoning stays in SWI-Prolog. Client-supplied values never reach Prolog source (validated against allowlists), no secrets are hardcoded, and the session state is server-side. No critical security vulnerabilities were found. The issues below are functional gaps and cleanup items, not security defects.
1.1  'nausea' is a dead routing key — the system can never detect it.

items: diseases.yaml routes nausea → [diabetes, anemia] and lists it as a diabetes entry symptom.
But 'nausea' is NOT in ALLOWED_FACTS (llm_extractor.py) and NOT in FALLBACK_KEYWORDS, so neither the LLM nor the fallback extractor can ever produce it.
Effect: a patient saying 'I feel nauseous' is silently ignored, losing a real diabetes/anemia signal.
extract_symptoms() and the SYMPTOM_KEYWORDS dict in app.py (lines 119-172) are never called — the old keyword extractor was superseded by llm_extractor.py.
The module docstring still says 'Symptom extraction: keyword rules (rule-based NLP)... no API key needed', which is now inaccurate (it uses a local LLM).
SESSIONS grows without limit; entries are only evicted lazily inside _get_session() when that exact id is looked up again.
A long-running server accumulates dead sessions indefinitely. No background sweeper.
It is a diabetes question fact. It works on the pending-question yes/no path (bypasses the allowlist), but the LLM can never emit it — inconsistent.
In static/index.html the JS card uses className 'diagnosis-card', but the CSS defines '.screening-card'. The green diagnosis card renders unstyled.

blocks.text: 3.2  family_member / historical observations are silently discarded.

items: apply_extraction skips any observation that is not current-patient. Intentional and safe, but the polarity/subject/temporality the LLM extracts is only partially used.
No hardcoded secrets; no os.system / shell=True / eval / pickle.
Injection-resistant Prolog bridge — client values validated against ALLOWED_FACTS before run_prolog.
Server-side session state with client-injection guard, covered by tests.
Robust error handling on both the Ollama call and the Prolog subprocess.
Add 'nausea' to ALLOWED_FACTS and FALLBACK_KEYWORDS (highest value).
Fix the CSS class in static/index.html ('diagnosis-card' → 'screening-card').
Add a periodic sweep to prune expired sessions from SESSIONS.
Remove or repurpose the dead extract_symptoms() / SYMPTOM_KEYWORDS code and correct the module docstring.
Optionally add 'high_hba1c' to ALLOWED_FACTS for consistency.
